title: Final Probability Expression
description: Essential Criteria: The final probability P must be correctly expressed as approximately 16%.

title: Energy and Potential Relation
description: Important Criteria: The relationship between the energy E and the potential V(x) must be correctly established for the nonclassical region.

title: Classical Region Boundaries
description: Important Criteria: The conditions defining the boundaries of the classical region must be accurately derived, specifically x^2 > 1/alpha.

title: Integration Setup
description: Important Criteria: The integrals for calculating the probability must be correctly set up, including the limits and the wave function squared.

title: Common Mistakes
description: Pitfall Criteria: Errors in the integration limits or incorrect evaluation of the integrals will lead to a loss of points.
